verdict.rationale: HubSpot docs confirm automatic deduplication of contacts by email and companies by domain, plus manual dedupe/merge via record IDs for contacts, companies, deals, tickets, and custom objects. Merging via record IDs is documented to preserve data as HubSpot's standard workflow for consolidating duplicate records. missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation that no data is lost during merges, and details on bulk/automated merge tooling beyond manual record-ID merges.
